The researchers and students involved have been de-identified.

Overall Comments:

➢ Had the audio quality been better, the responses might have been more realistic. The assessment done on the videos is more from the visual clues only.
➢ The duration of the videos have varied widely: from 4 minutes 7 seconds to 12 minutes 23 seconds causing difficulty in judging based on some uniformity. The viewing of the videos took more than four hours.
➢ In all the cases, cross checked the portfolio to corroborate the video assessment.However, many of the portfolios appeared to be incomplete. Therefore, inaudible video cues and incomplete portfolios may not be enough to judge the actual performance of the students.
➢ To sum up, probably only 50% of the assessment that I did here, may concur with the actual performances and markings done by the examiners who were conducting the examinations.
➢ In future, a transcript of the videos may be provided for better independent assessment.
